# config.schema { #keecas.config.schema }

`schema`

Configuration schema definitions and version registry for keecas.

Manages schema versions, deprecated keys, renamed keys, and migration functions
to handle breaking configuration changes across package versions.

## Classes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [](`~keecas.config.schema.ConfigSchema`) | Schema definition for a specific config version. |

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [](`~keecas.config.schema.migrate_0_1_to_1_0`) | Migrate config from 0.1.x to 1.0.0 |
| [](`~keecas.config.schema.get_current_schema_version`) | Get the current/latest schema version. |
| [](`~keecas.config.schema.get_schema`) | Get schema definition for a specific version. |
